a1.say: Let's solve Count the 1 Bits, using the Clear the Lowest Bit approach.

a1.cap: Return how many 1 bits the binary form of the non-negative integer n has.

lines: Return how many 1 bits the binary form of the non-negative integer n has.

a1.cap: For example, with n = 11, the answer is 3. 11 is 1011 in binary.

a1.cap: Subtracting 1 flips the lowest 1 bit and every 0 below it, so n & (n − 1) removes exactly one 1 bit. Count how many times you can do that before n reaches 0.
